## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix the proof check before merge because it can mark a requirement as proven without any criteria.

## Changes

The pull request replaces the requirement proof check with a count comparison and adds a helper that checks whether every entry in a nonempty batch was reviewed. It adds tests for both helpers.

## Critical

- app/proof.py:3 — correctness — Require at least one criterion for proof — `requirement_proven([])` returns `True` because both the sum and the list length are zero. The previous check required a nonempty collection. — A caller can report a requirement as proven when it has no supporting criteria. — Fix: Restore the nonempty guard and extend `test_requirement_with_evidence`.
